data.title: 佐天泪子 · 纸网还没破
data.description: 夏夜的小摊前，泪子把纸网慢慢伸进水里，耐心等一条金鱼游近。她侧过脸冲你笑，手腕却一点也没乱动。
data.promptProse: Ruiko kneels at a festival goldfish stall in a pale lilac floral yukata and teal obi. She lowers a paper scoop into the shallow water basin and smiles sideways toward the viewer without moving her wrist. The stall lanterns reflect on the water and small goldfish.
data.animaCaption: Her paper scoop is partly submerged beside a goldfish, with its delicate surface still intact.
data.action: 把纸网慢慢放进浅水盆等金鱼靠近
